title: Heats well, nice flames.
text:
Heats well, nice flames.. This fire place looks very nice. The flame looks realistic, but the burning coal is a little too much, in my opinion. It's a huge heap for such a small fireplace. It is a little noisy, not bad though. My biggest problem with the stove is the loud beep when you use the remote to change the flame or heat. I can't find a way to turn it off or to lower the sound. If you want to turn it off at night and others are sleeping, it might disturb them.

It does heat well and the flames are nice.

product_metadata.title: Duraflame Electric, Bronze Infrared Quartz Fireplace Stove
features: The Infrared heat helps to maintain the natural humidity within the air, resulting in moist, comfortable heat without drying out the room's air
5,200 BTU heater provides supplemental zone heating for up to 1,000 square feet
Metal construction gracefully fashioned with an arched door
Realistic flame effect with glowing log and ember bed can be operated with or without heat, providing the ambiance of a gentle rolling fire all year long

description: Enjoy the warmth and beauty of this infrared quartz electric stove. Gracefully fashioned with an arched door, it's well-suited for small spaces, hallways, or vestibules. The infrared quartz heater is capable of providing supplemental zone heating in a room up to 1,000 square feet. The infrared heat helps to maintain the natural humidity within the air, resulting in moist, comfortable heat without drying out the room's air. It's safe to use around kids and pets because it stays cool to the touch.
